component.name: SSH Config Manager
component.summary: Edit your SSH configuration, keys and known hosts

description.p: SSH Config Manager reads and writes the files in your ~/.ssh directory. It shows every host your configuration defines, the settings ssh applies to each one, and the problems that make a connection fail.

ul.li: Edit host blocks without losing comments, spacing or quoting
See the settings ssh applies to a host, including files it includes
List your keys with fingerprint, size and randomart
Generate an Ed25519 or ECDSA key
See which keys your agent holds, and unload one
Review known_hosts and forget a key
Find weak algorithms, loose permissions and duplicate aliases
Keep a version of every file the app writes, and put one back

description.p: First Linux release of the graphical application.
